methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: "3l5s"
description: Use when a problem is unclear, noisy, repeatedly reworked, or too large to execute directly; also use when a task list looks structured but may not be executable, verifiable, or tied to a falsifiable problem.
---
methods.method_binding_question: 针对这个事项，是否存在尚未形成可复述/可定位/可证伪的问题，或已明确但不能直接执行/验证的工作，需要Discovery/Definition或单层BTGSB？普通已确定的编辑不因是任务就进入3L5S。
methods.positive_example: 嘈杂故障现象需收敛成可证伪问题。
methods.negative_example: 目标和步骤均确定的文字替换直接处理。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `3l5s` | Problem-definition failure or work too large to execute. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: edsp
description: "Use when an ambiguous qualitative judgment needs Extreme Deduction and optional Scenario Projection: push variables to extremes, build a structural coordinate system, diagnose malformed propositions, then project concrete scenarios when needed."
---
methods.method_binding_question: 当前定性选择是否存在不稳定维度/合成二选一或结构歧义，需要先做Extreme Deduction建立结构？仅缺外部事实不以EDSP补洞；已稳定候选的共享资源分配交SRA。
methods.positive_example: 两个选择都局部成立且维度未稳。
methods.negative_example: 比较轴明确、只缺实际报价时先取数。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `edsp` | False binary or structural ambiguity; A/B 都像对. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: sela
description: Use for long-term system-efficiency versus local-advantage direction pressure, especially old paradigm vs scalable system or external system efficiency vs local/internal advantage; when concrete carrier/exposure/path action is also present, use as a support lens with MPG rather than sole owner.
---
methods.method_binding_question: 当前是否存在长期系统费效优势与真实局部优势之间的方向判断？裸A/B价格比较不自动进入SELA；若具体承载/投入路径决定当前动作，SELA是方向支持而不是吸收MPG。
methods.positive_example: 可扩展系统与真实但难规模化的局部优势冲突。
methods.negative_example: 同类两工具一次报价比较不是长期系统压力。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `sela` | Long-term system efficiency versus local advantage; carrier/path action defers to MPG. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: mpg
description: Use when a plausible mainline or strategic direction meets a concrete carrier/proxy, concentrated scarce-resource exposure, or continue/commit/hold/exit/switch decision under path volatility, costs, delays, fragility, or counter-forces; not for method-reference evidence review.
---
methods.method_binding_question: 是否有已提出的主线/目标、会改变承载的非线性路径，以及行动者当前需配置载体/暴露/时机/去留？主线可受质疑，不要求已经证明正确；仅审查以前MPG答案时方法是审查对象。
methods.positive_example: 长期方向可行但当前承载脆弱且需决定继续或切换。
methods.negative_example: 只问长期方向，没有载体/路径行动。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `mpg` | Mainline plus carrier, exposure, path volatility, and commitment; no carrier/exposure/path, no MPG. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: sra
description: "Use directly when multiple already-judgeable actions or bundles compete for one named scarce resource; choose the current floor and next meaningful tranche. Default Lite; use Full for explicit bundles, multiple resource constraints, fixed thresholds, or major commitments. Do not use with missing comparison facts/resource, or for one selected mainline's carrier, exposure, timing, or exit."
---
methods.method_binding_question: 是否有多个已足以比较的行动或组合争夺同一具名稀缺资源，需要决定保底和下一份值得投入的资源？缺候选事实/资源不能编造；唯一必需下一步或直接尝试更便宜可直接处理。
methods.positive_example: 已比较清楚的修复争夺两天人力。
methods.negative_example: 只有唯一必修动作，或只有项目名没有资源与事实。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `sra` | Multiple valid candidates share a common scarce resource and are judgeable; choose next tranche, ceiling, defer/stop, reserve, or rerank. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: wae
description: Use when a workflow, script, schema, agent loop, evidence gate, or review step may be controlling the wrong part of the work; especially when clean structure may be freezing uncertain truth or hiding thin judgment.
---
methods.method_binding_question: 事项是否属于LLM/Agent/Skill/脚本/工作流/证据门等系统，且存在谁应控制路径、语义或证据的错配？有缺陷的被审系统正可分析；普通组织边界或格式化不自动WAE。
methods.positive_example: schema全绿被错误当作语义已验收的自动化系统。
methods.negative_example: 一般办公室流程排序且无agentic控制错配。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `wae` | Agentic-system Workflow / Agentic / Evidence mismatch; no controller mismatch, no WAE. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: tvg
description: Use as a value-directed strengthening loop for bounded AI artifacts that need clearer judgment, evidence, trade-offs, handoff, reuse, or action value.
---
methods.method_binding_question: 是否已有边界明确的AI产物和可说明的价值增益目标，需把产物往该good标准改进？它不是所有审计/长文的默认归宿，TVG audit只属于进行中的TVG loop。
methods.positive_example: 有界方案已写成但缺交接决策依据。
methods.negative_example: 独立发布审计或从零无目标写稿不自动TVG。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `tvg` | Bounded artifact is thin with a named value-gain target; TVG audit needs an active loop; external audits stay object-routed. |

methods.card_excerpt:
---
name: tplan
description: "Use when an AI agent needs an OKR-Runtime: a Mission needs script-driven task state, acceptance evidence, decision hooks, human-in-loop authority, or Mission-relative addition, subtraction, selection, closure, and recovery."
---
methods.method_binding_question: 当前是否确需持续Mission状态、acceptance证据、决策hook或人类授权/恢复，而不只是任务复杂？TPlan拥有状态和合法变更，语义问题仍由原责任方及相应方法处理。
methods.positive_example: 跨会话多节点任务需要持久状态与恢复权限。
methods.negative_example: 一次复杂分析无需Mission状态机。

canonical_routing_row.text: | `tplan` | Durable Mission state, recovery, or human authority; ordinary complexity is insufficient. |

companion_clauses.trigger: SELA直接加载且当前事项存在载体、暴露、路径波动或继续/退出承诺。
companion_clauses.consequence: 实际读取MPG并完成所需伴随检查；SELA校准方向，MPG主导路径动作。

companion_clauses.trigger: MPG直接加载且主线基于系统效率/趋势。
companion_clauses.consequence: 路径策略前实际读取SELA并完成方向支持检查。
